shader_exit.screen.title: ShaderExit · Shader Bypass
shader_exit.screen.subtitle: Choose which mods bypass the shader pack
shader_exit.screen.toggle_hint: ON renders these overlays without shader pack effects. OFF restores the mod's original rendering. Changes apply and save immediately.
shader_exit.screen.saved_hint: Changes apply immediately and are saved automatically.
shader_exit.screen.save_failed: Could not save settings. Check the log; the change was not applied.
shader_exit.mod.minihud: Shapes, boundaries and other world overlays drawn through MaLiLib. Does not affect the HUD text.
shader_exit.mod.tweakeroo: World overlays drawn through MaLiLib, such as placement guides. Does not affect the mod's other features.
shader_exit.mod.litematica: Selection boxes and other world overlays drawn through MaLiLib. Does not affect schematic blocks.
shader_exit.mod.tweakermore: World overlays drawn by TweakerMore. Does not affect its other tweaks.
shader_exit.mod.malilib: Other world overlays drawn through MaLiLib. Mods listed separately follow their own switches.
shader_exit.mod.minecraft: Vanilla debug shapes and gizmos, such as chunk borders. Does not affect normal world rendering.
shader_exit.mod.carpet: Carpet's scarpet shapes and Carpet TIS Addition's micro-timing markers. Both use Carpet's renderer and share this switch.
